construct.lineage: The shared canonical model of what a construct IS. Its type-level anatomy spine is materialized as canonical graph relations; its runtime firing is a TRACE verified per Moment, never a static relation; its verify arc ends in an independently observed health assessment that EVIDENCES an explicit objective-satisfaction claim. Consumed by every construct through APPLIES_IN (conformance) and DEPENDS_ON (operational dependency); owned by no single toolkit. Promoted from the model first authored in [[space:l2:mind-universe:abstraction-toolkit-v0]].
construct.name: Construct-validity v0 — the canonical construct protocol (every construct APPLIES_IN it)
construct.purpose: Give the Universe one shared, canonical protocol every construct APPLIES_IN: a type-level anatomy spine materialized in the graph, a runtime trace verified per firing, and a verify arc whose independently observed health EVIDENCES an explicit satisfaction claim about the objective. A construct is valid only while a FRESH, independently observed health_assessment evidences that claim; a stale reading yields 'stale', never 'healthy'. The protocol is universal; the execution mechanism is not.

root_content.applies_to: every construct in the Universe, present and future — each APPLIES_IN this one protocol, declares exactly one execution profile, and reports its validity as the fresh, independently observed health this protocol derives. Not a capability toolkit (like sky/mechanical); the canonical protocol itself. This construct APPLIES_IN the protocol it defines, at the deterministic profile. Non-construct kernel entities are out of scope.

conformance_vocabulary.APPLIES_IN: CONFORMANCE. The construct's structure is claimed to satisfy this protocol. Semantic and validatable: a conformance check can pass or fail it. Every construct carries exactly one.
conformance_vocabulary.DEPENDS_ON: OPERATIONAL DEPENDENCY. The construct needs the target to do its work. Causal, not structural. Conformance implies nothing about it, and it implies nothing about conformance.
conformance_vocabulary.why_distinct: The prior revision had eight constructs pointing at this definition with DEPENDS_ON and read that as evidence of conformance. A dependency is not a conformance claim; it says the target is needed, not that the source is shaped correctly.

effect_protocol.CommittedDelta: Proven AFTER the commit, by reading the thing itself. The authoritative state of a node is the node.
effect_protocol.ExpectedEffects: Declared BEFORE the action, on the ActionIntent. A claim about what should happen. Never evidence.
chain: ActionIntent — what is being attempted, carrying ExpectedEffects (a declared claim, not a result)
validate + authorize — gates ON this step; a failure here ends the chain and is itself recorded
EffectIntent — the authorized request routed to an authorized transport
EffectReceipt — what the transport actually returned, including a failure or a timeout
CommitReceipt — the tick-boundary commit of the semantic transaction
CommittedDelta — read back independently from the node itself; this, not the Moment, is what proves the effect
forbidden: reporting ExpectedEffects as if they were a CommittedDelta
treating an EffectReceipt as proof of a semantic change (it proves a transport result, nothing more)
treating a Moment as a substitute for reading the node back
any path from a decision to a change that skips validate + authorize
effect_protocol.note: The one path from a decision to a proven change. No construct — including maintenance — has a shortcut around it.

agentic.clock_note: The inference paces THAT ACTOR'S TURN. It is not the Universe's clock: the causal/physics runtime is. An inference-paced world cannot reach the throughput a city needs, and the great majority of constructs never infer at all.
agentic.mechanism: one local Ollama inference, serial, one call in flight, assembling a bounded WorldObservation and returning a candidate IntentProposal
agentic.woken_by: self-wake on cognitive activity (L1 actors only; L2 and L3 never initiate)

deterministic.examples: a validator, a counter, a projection, a conformance check — and this construct itself
deterministic.mechanism: the fuel-bounded, mutation-free VM over a graph-native Causal IR CodeDefinition
deterministic.woken_by: invocation by another construct, or by an observer run; it does not self-wake

execution_profiles.note: The PROOF protocol is universal. The EXECUTION mechanism is not. A construct declares exactly one profile; the conformance check requires the parts and feedback kinds that profile needs, and forbids the rest.

reactive.examples: house alarm, seal gate, entry membrane, orientation beacon
reactive.mechanism: the construct's authored atom circuit: Sensor -> DepositBond -> trigger atom -> Threshold -> Effect
reactive.woken_by: a physics event crossing an authored threshold, reported by the solver for free (never a scan, never a poll)

root_content.name: Construct-validity v0 — the canonical construct protocol (every construct APPLIES_IN it)
root_content.native_law_boundary: AtomDynamics knows only AtomSpec, AtomBond and support/inhibit/neutral. This construct adds no law; it is the canonical DEFINITION of the protocol every construct conforms to. The parts, edges, profiles, runtime moments and maintenance affordances are data, not native dispatch. Because `support` is a bond polarity in that law, no semantic relation in this protocol is named SUPPORTS.

parent_scope.justification: A shared canonical contract awaiting installation under the sensemaking/meta registry Space. Exactly one scope classification; conformed to via APPLIES_IN and consumed via DEPENDS_ON, structurally owned by none.

protocol.closure_rule: A construct is causally closed when the feedback kinds its execution profile requires are present, each with the semantics its kind demands. Closure is a property of the KIND set, never of a count. A protocol that demanded all six of every construct would demand environmental feedback from a validator and inference from a counter.

counts.counts_are_not_a_conformance_rule: These describe THIS revision. A construct is never checked against a count. What is checked is: the required parts for its execution profile resolve, the type spine traverses, and the feedback kinds its profile requires are present.

feedback_edges.note: A dependency of knowledge, not a temporal loop. It re-injects no energy, no state and no action; it says each non-compensatory gate rests on the same independently measured evidence the objective is JUSTIFIED_BY.

Replaces the prior 'health SUPPORTS objective'. An unsatisfied or stale satisfaction claim raises a failure front that maintenance answers. This is the edge that actually re-drives the construct; the prior one only looked like it did.
Only what commits stays authoritative, and 'recent receipts' re-enter the WorldObservation that drives the next turn. Meaningless for a construct with no Inputs; required for an agentic one.

The changed world may produce new physics events. It does NOT follow that THIS construct re-wakes: the sensor that fires next may belong to another construct entirely. Declaring this edge REQUIRES declaring rearm_semantics (latch, consumption, reset, cooldown, hysteresis, dedup, idempotency); without them it is self-excitation, oscillation and repeated effect.

Mutating a claim invalidates its prior signature and re-opens the seal, so the signatures_valid support de-conducts and the gate cannot fire until re-sealed. A rule for SEALED constructs, not a universal law.

Repair re-enters implementation THROUGH the ordinary effect protocol — FailureFront -> RepairProposal -> ActionIntent -> validate -> authorize -> EffectIntent -> EffectReceipt -> Moment -> re-observation — never as a direct mutation. Maintenance holds no privileged authority.

protocol.note: The construct protocol. Parts and edges are described here as a MODEL; the type edges below are additionally materialized as canonical graph relations, and the trace edges deliberately are not.

anatomy.Affordances: The reachable action verbs, each with an exact target, precondition and justification; an unproven target is never offered as a verb.
anatomy.CommittedDelta: What actually changed, read back independently from the node after commit. The authoritative state of a node is the node; this is what proves an effect.
anatomy.ExpectedEffects: What the construct DECLARES it will change, carried on the ActionIntent before validation. A claim. Never evidence, never a receipt.
anatomy.Inputs: AGENTIC profile: what the turn consumes — the WorldObservation prompt (two frames plus context: role, needs and energy, memory, objective, recent receipts).
anatomy.Mechanism: How it works — DISPATCHED BY EXECUTION PROFILE. Reactive: the authored atom circuit. Deterministic: the fuel-bounded, mutation-free VM over graph-native Causal IR. Agentic: one local Ollama inference, serial, one in flight, pacing that actor's turn only. No profile's mechanism is the Universe's clock.
anatomy.Preconditions: Measured, all_required, non-compensatory conditions gating the Mechanism (missing_binding -> not_measured_and_inert); each gate DEPENDS_ON independently measured/observed evidence.
anatomy.Receipts: The durable record of what was asked and what a transport returned. Only what commits stays authoritative — and the record never stands in for looking.
anatomy.loop_space: The L2 construct spine; roots and GOVERNS the protocol instance and declares reads/writes/forbidden_effects and exactly one parent_scope. A Construct is what a Toolkit produces: the built, self-verifying thing placed in a world.

claim.objective_satisfaction: The explicit claim 'this construct currently satisfies its objective', standing between derived health and the objective itself. Health EVIDENCES it; it MEASURES the objective. Without it, derived health would attach directly to the objective — and since SUPPORTS is an atom bond polarity, that edge would modulate the objective's own energy rather than the confidence in its satisfaction.

maintenance.maintenance: Reversible repair affordances keyed to failing health states. Repair is an ORDINARY action: FailureFront -> RepairProposal -> ActionIntent -> validate -> authorize -> EffectIntent -> EffectReceipt -> Moment -> re-observation. Maintenance has no privileged write path; a repair system exempt from the guarantees it repairs is the largest hole a construct can have.

roles.algorithm: Role 5/12: the ordered steps refining behavior; DEFINED_BY code.
roles.behavior: Role 4/12: the given/when/then/forbidden observable contract; SHAPED by pattern, USES_VOCABULARY, REFINED_BY algorithm, VALIDATED_BY validation.
roles.code: Role 6/12: the graph-native CodeDefinition (causal-expression-ast / health AST / atom circuit), no implicit Python; REALIZED_BY implementation, CHALLENGED_BY validation.
roles.health: Role 12/12: derived state (healthy/degraded/stale/unknown/not_measured/measurement_failed) from a fresh metric vector; FED by metric, EVIDENCES objective_satisfaction, REPAIRED_BY maintenance.
roles.implementation: Role 7/12: the honest realized state with graph-defined/wired/running/verified kept as DISTINCT fields; REALIZED_BY code, OBSERVED_BY the observer.
roles.justification: Role 8/12: whyItSatisfiesObjective plus rejectedAlternatives (the roads not taken); the objective is JUSTIFIED_BY this, and every gate DEPENDS_ON the same evidence.
roles.metric: Role 11/12: the metric VECTOR (forbidOpaqueAggregate; per-dimension spec, provenance and freshness, no collapsed scalar); PRODUCED by the observer, FEEDS health.
roles.objective: Role 1/12: the observable success_condition / semantic promise; GOVERNED by loop_space, JUSTIFIED_BY justification, and MEASURED by objective_satisfaction.
roles.observability_algorithm: Role 10/12: the INDEPENDENT observer; mustNotTrust implementation health claim / renderer success flag / process running state / file presence; OBSERVES implementation via readback, PRODUCES the metric, is itself VERIFIED_BY observer_validation and carries its own trust_provenance rung.
roles.pattern: Role 2/12: the design rationale / reusable shape (evidence-bearing spine that separates identity, execution, observation, measurement, health and repair); ADDRESSES objective, SHAPES behavior.
roles.validation: Role 9/12: fixtures plus invariants challenging code/behavior; its execution PRODUCES a validation_run (never pre-created).
roles.vocabulary: Role 3/12: the terms plus forbiddenConflations (running!=healthy, empty!=known_absent, missing_value!=0, rendered!=committed, file_exists!=deployed, expected!=committed, conformance!=dependency); USED by behavior.

runtime_moment.ActionIntent: The intent a PhysicsEvent is lifted into (or the IntentProposal the L3 body attempts); carries ExpectedEffects; validated and authorized before any effect.
runtime_moment.EffectIntent: After validate + authorize, the authorized request routed to an authorized transport.
runtime_moment.EffectReceipt: What the transport actually returned — success, failure or timeout. Proof of a transport result, never of a semantic change.
runtime_moment.IntentProposal: AGENTIC only: the candidate the inference returns — one chosen verb on an exact target with its justification. The model proposes; the world disposes; the inference never touches the store.
runtime_moment.Moment: The committed terminal of the chain: the authoritative, inspectable record (CommitReceipt / inscription_receipt).
runtime_moment.PhysicsEvent: The observed sensor intersection / threshold event; it never mutates the Universe directly.
runtime_moment.health_assessment: Produced by health derivation from a FRESH metric vector (precreated:false): assessment_id, observer_run_ref, trust_rung, metric_samples, derived_state, derived_at, fresh_until, evidence_refs, failure_front.
runtime_moment.validation_run: Produced by validation execution (precreated:false): run_id, construct_id, validation_id, fixture_results, invariant_results, evidence_refs, execution_status.
runtime_moment.wake-queue: The physics step fills it; the single continuous serial loop drains it so each construct takes its turn and dormant constructs cost nothing.

trigger.DepositBond: REACTIVE part 2: on the physics event, +energy onto a trigger atom — a Support BOND (atom polarity, not a semantic relation), stamped energy_status measured.
trigger.Sensor: REACTIVE profile part 1: a physical condition (e.g. a collider on an entry membrane) placed in the field. Self-wake, never poll.
trigger.Threshold: REACTIVE part 3: the atom fires at support >= N; the moment-to-act is a threshold the solver reports for free, not a scan.
trigger.rearm_semantics: A threshold that fires must state its re-arm discipline, or environmental feedback becomes self-excitation: latch, energy consumption on fire, reset/rearm condition, cooldown, hysteresis, causal de-duplication key, and idempotency key. A construct that declares environmental feedback without these is non-conformant.
trigger.trigger atom: The atom a DepositBond deposits +energy onto; accrues supporting energy and fires once support >= N.

agentic_chain: Inputs -> consumed as the WorldObservation prompt -> Mechanism
Affordances -> offered to the inference (proven targets only) -> IntentProposal
wake-queue -> the serial loop drains it, giving each construct its turn -> Mechanism
Mechanism -> the inference returns a candidate -> IntentProposal
IntentProposal -> rises to the L3 body, which attempts it -> ActionIntent
effect_chain: Preconditions -> gate the mechanism (all_required, non-compensatory) -> Mechanism
ActionIntent -> carries what it claims it will change -> ExpectedEffects
Moment -> read the node back independently -> CommittedDelta
trace_edges.note: The shape of ONE firing. These are NOT graph relations and must never be stored as such: a firing is an event, not a permanent fact about the world. A conformance check verifies this shape against a committed Moment chain, per firing, and reports `not_measured` when no firing has occurred.
reactive_chain: implementation -> wired into the field -> Sensor
Sensor -> physics event fires the sensor -> DepositBond
trigger atom -> fires at support >= N -> Threshold
Threshold -> enqueues the woken construct -> wake-queue
Sensor -> the intersection is observed (never mutates) -> PhysicsEvent
PhysicsEvent -> lifted (never mutates the Universe) -> ActionIntent
verify_chain: CommittedDelta -> independently re-observed as fresh evidence -> observability_algorithm

root_content.purpose: Give the Universe one shared, canonical protocol every construct APPLIES_IN: a type-level anatomy spine materialized in the graph, a runtime trace verified per firing, and a verify arc whose independently observed health EVIDENCES an explicit satisfaction claim about the objective. A construct is valid only while a FRESH, independently observed health_assessment evidences that claim; a stale reading yields 'stale', never 'healthy'. The protocol is universal; the execution mechanism is not.

revision_gate.additionally_required: If the TARGET construct declares its own `capability_gate`, that port must admit as well. Both gates are required; neither substitutes for the other.
revision_gate.note: The door to revising ANY construct that APPLIES_IN this protocol. It is DATA, read from this node at revision time; it is not a constant in a binary. A revision tool that cannot find this gate in the graph must refuse — there is no fallback, because a fallback would silently replace missing Universe state with a native default and that is exactly how an ungated write path is reintroduced.
revision_gate.receipt: An admitted revision commits an EffectReceipt Moment in the SAME atomic transaction as the change, so there is no window in which a canonical construct is revised without an attributable holder behind it. A refused revision commits a REJECTION receipt recording the actor's actually-held set and the required capability, so the refusal is audited rather than silently dropped.
revision_gate.rule: A construct revision is admitted only when the acting capability set — READ from the actor's graph-held USED edges, never from a self-declared request field — contains authority:construct-revision. Perceiving a construct, depending on it, or conforming to it grants none of it.
revision_gate.why_a_gate_here: Revising a construct changes what it promises, what its invariants forbid, and — for this construct — the protocol every other construct conforms to. That is a heavier act than changing a file under the city, and it should be held by an actor with a name, not available to whoever runs a binary. Before this gate, `revise_construct` wrote six transactions attributed to nobody.

changed: DELETED the invariant 'the loop has 34 parts and 42 edges, exactly 6 of which are feedback' — a count is a description of one revision, never a conformance rule.

SPLIT the single edge list into type_edges (materialized as canonical graph relations, traversable and validatable) and trace_edges (the shape of ONE firing; verified per Moment, never stored as a static relation).
ADDED spine_encoding: the authored spine predicate -> canonical stored predicate map, with direction, so the stored graph provably encodes the spine and interns zero new symbols.

REPLACED 'health SUPPORTS objective' with 'health EVIDENCES objective_satisfaction SATISFIES objective'. SUPPORTS is the AtomDynamics bond polarity; a semantic claim edge must never share a name with an atom polarity, or derived health would deposit energy onto the objective itself.

SPLIT the 'Effects' part into ExpectedEffects (declared before the action; a claim) and CommittedDelta (proven after the commit; read back from the node), and DELETED the duplicate EffectIntent -> Effects -> Receipts path.
TYPED the feedback edges by kind (epistemic / control / state / environmental / invalidation / repair) instead of one boolean.

ADDED execution_profiles (reactive / deterministic / agentic). The prior Mechanism mandated one local Ollama inference for EVERY construct and called the inference 'the clock'. A gate, a counter, a validator and a projection need no LLM, and an inference-paced clock cannot reach the throughput the Universe needs.

ADDED trust_provenance: a graded, terminating ladder (self_reported < observed < cross_observed < fixture_verified < kernel_verified) so 'who validates the observer's validation' stops at an inspectable root instead of recursing.

ADDED metric dimension_specs: per dimension, what measures it, its type, the provenance it requires, its freshness TTL and how it composes into health — the declarations a health derivation must have to be a program rather than a description.
ROUTED maintenance through the ordinary effect protocol: repair is an ActionIntent like any other, never a privileged direct mutation of implementation.

GATED revision itself. Added revision_gate: revising any construct that APPLIES_IN this protocol now requires authority:construct-revision, READ from the acting actor's graph-held USED edges and adjudicated by a SealedCapabilityPort. A refusal commits a rejection receipt; an admission commits its EffectReceipt in the SAME transaction as the change. The gate was placed by one last ungated write (store revision 320) and enforced from then on — the same chicken-and-egg bootstrap the underground toolkit had.
revision_reason.prior_shape: 34 parts / 42 edges / 6 boolean feedback edges, carried entirely as root content
rejected: Materializing all 42 edges as graph relations. Roughly two thirds of them are trace edges (Sensor -> DepositBond -> trigger atom -> Threshold -> ... -> Moment). Storing a firing as a permanent fact would cement exactly the conflation of the three loops that this revision separates.

Renaming the stored relations to the spine predicates. GOVERNS / ADDRESSED_BY / SHAPES / REFINED_BY / REALIZED_BY are not canonical symbols; minting them is a hard error by design. The spine is ENCODED in canonical predicates and the encoding is now stated, which is traversable where a renamed symbol set would not be.

Adding ValidationReceipt / AuthorizationReceipt / TransportAttempt as node kinds. Validation and authorization are gates ON the ActionIntent -> EffectIntent step; a transport attempt is what an EffectReceipt records. Three new kinds to disambiguate a naming collision is not worth its cost; naming ExpectedEffects vs CommittedDelta resolves it.
Keeping a count as an invariant so the model has a memorable closure. Numerology promoted to a conformance rule breaks the moment the protocol splits by execution profile — which it now does.
revision_reason.why: The prior revision described one undifferentiated 34-part / 42-edge loop as CONTENT while the graph carried only ten type-level relations. That is not two ontologies; it is one spine with an unstated encoding, plus a runtime trace that was never a graph fact. This revision (a) states the encoding, (b) separates type edges from trace edges, (c) replaces the health->objective energy edge with an explicit satisfaction claim, (d) splits declared from committed effects, (e) types the feedback edges, and (f) stops assuming every construct is an inferring agent.

spine_encoding.note: The type-level spine is authored in spine vocabulary and STORED in canonical predicates. This table is the encoding, carried in the graph so a reader can traverse the stored edges and recover the spine. Interning a new symbol for a spine predicate is a hard error; encoding it is not a compromise but the mechanism by which the spine stays traversable.

role_bindings.note: Which entity each type_edge role name resolves to. Data, so a conformance check needs no naming convention baked into native code.

why_these_canonical_choices.EVIDENCES -> SUPPORTS_ESTIMATE: The canonical predicate for 'this evidence bears on that estimate' is exactly what a health assessment does to a satisfaction claim — and unlike SUPPORTS it is not an atom bond polarity.
why_these_canonical_choices.SATISFIES -> MEASURES: A satisfaction claim is a measurement OF the objective, not a part of it.
why_these_canonical_choices.SHAPES -> DERIVED_FROM (swapped): Nearest canonical predicate; the behavior is derived from the pattern.
why_these_canonical_choices.USES_VOCABULARY -> USED: The behavior holds and uses the vocabulary. DEPENDS_ON was rejected here: this protocol gives DEPENDS_ON one job — the operational edge BETWEEN constructs, the counterpart of APPLIES_IN — and reusing it for an intra-construct relation would blur exactly the distinction the conformance_vocabulary draws.

ladder: self_reported — the thing's own account of itself. Never evidence. Carried, never derived from.
observed — read back independently from the store by a party that is not the implementation.
cross_observed — two independent observers agree, at least one of which did not author the construct.
fixture_verified — the observer itself passed a deterministic fault-injection fixture (it detected a planted fault and refused a planted missing proof).
kernel_verified — the claim rests only on trusted-computing-base primitives: atomic write, independent readback, signature check, fuel bound.
trust_provenance.note: Terminates the 'who validates the validator' recursion at an inspectable root instead of recursing forever. A proof carries its rung; a construct never reports a rung it did not earn.
trust_provenance.root: kernel_verified is the root and does not recurse: it names the small, fixed set of native primitives whose correctness is assumed by everything else. Every other rung states what it assumed.
trust_provenance.rule: An observer that has not reached fixture_verified yields a WEAK proof, and the health assessment it feeds must say so. A weak proof is never upgraded by repetition.

steps: read the construct's declared execution_profile; resolve the required part set and required feedback kinds from it
traverse the type spine over CANONICAL stored relations, decoding each through spine_encoding; a spine edge that does not resolve is a conformance failure, not a missing symbol
verify no trace edge has been stored as a graph relation
run validation, which PRODUCES a validation_run (never pre-created)
wait: fire on a threshold (reactive), be invoked (deterministic), or be woken from the wake-queue (agentic). Never poll.
observe implementation independently by readback, and record the trust rung the observation earned
measure: PRODUCE the metric vector, each dimension against its dimension_spec, with provenance and freshness; a dimension without fresh evidence is not_measured, never 0
derive health from the FRESH metric vector by the declared composition rule, and render the failure front
EVIDENCE the objective_satisfaction claim from that health, with its own fresh_until; never write the claim from anything else
if the claim is unsatisfied or stale, raise the failure front to maintenance (control feedback) — which repairs through the ordinary effect protocol, never directly
re-observe: fold Moment back into Inputs (agentic) and CommittedDelta back onto Sensor/Threshold (reactive, under the declared rearm_semantics) so the construct re-arms rather than self-excites

forbidden: collapsing the metric vector into one opaque scalar
letting the implementation self-report its own health
treating a PhysicsEvent as a semantic mutation
pre-creating validation_run, health_assessment or objective_satisfaction
reusing a stale health_assessment or satisfaction claim as current
offering an unproven target as an affordance verb
storing a trace edge as a graph relation
reporting ExpectedEffects as a CommittedDelta
declaring environmental feedback without rearm_semantics
repairing implementation outside the effect protocol
requiring an inference from a construct whose profile is not agentic
checking conformance against a part or edge count
reading a DEPENDS_ON edge as evidence of conformance
reporting a trust rung the proof did not earn
content.given: A construct declaring exactly one execution profile, with its type spine materialized through spine_encoding, the parts its profile requires, its implementation in a stated realized state, and its verify arc (observer, metric, health, satisfaction claim).
content.loop_part: the given/when/then/forbidden observable contract of the protocol
then: the type spine resolves by traversing CANONICAL stored relations through spine_encoding: loop_space GOVERNS objective, ADDRESSED_BY pattern, SHAPES behavior, REFINED_BY algorithm, DEFINED_BY code, REALIZED_BY implementation
the parts required by the declared execution profile are present, and parts belonging to other profiles are not claimed
a reactive construct fires only at support >= N accumulated by measured Support bonds, and declares its rearm_semantics
a PhysicsEvent never mutates: it is lifted to an ActionIntent, validated, authorized, then an EffectIntent goes to an authorized transport
ExpectedEffects are carried before the action and never reported as a result; the effect is proven by reading the node back as a CommittedDelta
implementation is OBSERVED_BY an independent observer that PRODUCES a metric vector, at a stated trust rung, that FEEDS health
health EVIDENCES an objective_satisfaction claim with its own freshness; the objective is never modulated by health directly
the feedback kinds the profile requires are present, and repair reaches implementation only through the ordinary effect protocol
content.when: The construct fires (reactive), is invoked (deterministic) or takes its turn (agentic) — or an observer runs a conformance check over it.

content.authority: Graph-native CodeDefinition (causal-expression-ast / health AST / atom circuit); no implicit Python. This JSON file is a materialized projection, not independent semantic authority.
content.loop_part: the graph-native CodeDefinition of the protocol
content.model_note: This construct carries no atom circuit of its own; it is the canonical protocol definition consumed by other constructs via APPLIES_IN (conformance) and DEPENDS_ON (operational). Each conforming construct's own health face reports the fresh, independently observed health this protocol derives.

required_procedures.check_conformance: (construct_id, profile) -> ValidationRun. Resolves the type spine through spine_encoding, asserts the profile's required parts and feedback kinds, asserts no trace edge was stored as a relation, and asserts no forbidden claim.
required_procedures.derive_health: (MetricVector, freshness_policy) -> HealthAssessment -> ObjectiveSatisfaction. Composes by the declared rule, refuses to derive from a stale vector, and emits a satisfaction claim with its own fresh_until.
required_procedures.note: The three procedures a conformance check needs to be a PROGRAM rather than a description. Named and typed here; not yet compiled. Their absence is an honest gap, not a hidden fallback.
required_procedures.observe_implementation: (construct_id, freshness_policy) -> MetricVector. Independent readback per dimension_spec, each sample carrying provenance, trust rung and measured_at; an unmeasured dimension is not_measured, never 0.

content.evidences: health EVIDENCES objective_satisfaction — derived health bears on the CONFIDENCE that the objective is currently satisfied, and on nothing else. It does not attach to the objective, whose existence and energy are independent of it.
content.loop_part: derived state from a fresh metric vector; FED by metric, PRODUCES health_assessment, EVIDENCES objective_satisfaction, REPAIRED_BY maintenance
content.maintenance_path: Every one of these is an ActionIntent through the ordinary effect protocol: FailureFront -> RepairProposal -> ActionIntent -> validate -> authorize -> EffectIntent -> EffectReceipt -> Moment -> re-observation. None is a direct write to implementation.
content.no_healthy_without_fresh_assessment: No healthy state exists without a FRESH runtime health_assessment; a stale prior reading yields 'stale', never 'healthy'.
content.produces: a health_assessment runtime moment (precreated:false): assessment_id, observer_run_ref, trust_rung, metric_samples, derived_state, derived_at, fresh_until, evidence_refs, failure_front.
content.what_changed: The prior revision carried 'health SUPPORTS objective' as the loop-closing feedback. It was not a feedback at all — an objective is not re-driven by the health of the thing pursuing it — and SUPPORTS is the AtomDynamics bond polarity, so the edge would have modulated the objective's energy. The real control feedback runs objective_satisfaction -> maintenance.

content.honesty: The protocol is written into the live store as a construct, and its type spine is now materialized as canonical relations that a reader can traverse. No construct's validity is DERIVED by executing this protocol yet: the three required_procedures are declared and not compiled. graph-defined / wired / running / verified are kept as distinct fields: written is true; wired, running and verified are false. This describes the protocol faithfully; it does not yet execute it. These fields are this implementation's own account of itself and are self_reported, never evidence.
incoming: maintenance -> repair feedback -> implementation (through the effect protocol)
content.known_gap: A health assessment IS produced today for house-alarm-v0 by native Rust (crates/universe-e2e/src/bin/construct_live_run.rs), honestly reporting 4 measured / 14 not_measured. That is per-construct native code, not this protocol executing. Generalizing it into the three graph-authored required_procedures is the next increment.

content.loop_part: whyItSatisfiesObjective plus rejectedAlternatives; the objective is JUSTIFIED_BY this, and every gate DEPENDS_ON the same evidence
rejected: materializing every modelled edge as a graph relation (it would store firings as permanent facts and cement the conflation of the three loops)
minting GOVERNS / ADDRESSED_BY / SHAPES / REFINED_BY / REALIZED_BY as canonical symbols instead of encoding them (per-fixture symbol drift is exactly what the zero-new-symbols rule exists to prevent)
adding ValidationReceipt / AuthorizationReceipt / TransportAttempt node kinds (validation and authorization are gates on a step; a transport attempt is what an EffectReceipt records)
a one-way build->receipt chain that never invalidates itself (mutating a claim must re-open the seal so the gate cannot fire until re-sealed)
an implementation self-reporting its own health without an independent observer
an unproven observer (one below fixture_verified yields only a WEAK proof, and repetition never upgrades it)
one opaque overall health scalar that hides a per-dimension defect
attaching derived health straight to the objective (SUPPORTS is an atom bond polarity; that edge modulates energy, not confidence)
a fixed part/edge count as a conformance rule
pre-seeding or inferring runtime moments instead of PRODUCING them
why: A one-way sensor->effect->health pipeline ENDS at health and can never re-drive itself; the typed feedback edges are exactly what turn the anatomy spine into a genuine loop — and typing them stops six unlike things being counted as one.

Separating type edges from trace edges is what makes conformance CHECKABLE: a runtime can traverse a stored relation, and cannot traverse a sentence describing one. Storing the trace instead would make the world assert permanently something that happened once.

The spine_encoding table is what makes the stored canonical predicates and the authored spine ONE ontology with a stated mapping, rather than two that happen to describe the same thing. It also keeps the injection at zero new symbols, which is the rule that stops the canonical vocabulary from drifting per fixture.

An INDEPENDENT observer that mustNotTrust the implementation's health claim, the renderer's success flag, the process running-state or file presence keeps 'running != healthy' and 'rendered != committed' honest — and the trust ladder terminates the 'who checks the checker' recursion at kernel_verified instead of recursing.
Runtime moments (validation_run, health_assessment, objective_satisfaction) are PRODUCED by execution and never pre-created, so no construct self-certifies from a seeded value.
Freshness gating at BOTH the assessment and the satisfaction claim: a stale reading yields 'stale', never its last value.
The metric is a VECTOR with per-dimension spec, provenance and freshness (forbidOpaqueAggregate); a single red/green scalar is an explicitly rejected alternative.

Profiles keep the proof protocol universal without making the execution mechanism universal — a validator that had to infer, or a Universe clocked by an LLM, would be both false to what these things are and incapable of the throughput a city needs.
Maintenance goes through the ordinary effect protocol because a repair system exempt from the guarantees it repairs is the largest hole a construct can have.

content.composition_rule: healthy requires: every all_required dimension measured and passing, every applicable dimension fresh within its TTL, and the observer rung at fixture_verified or above. Any dimension not_measured yields not_measured overall — never a lower-confidence 'healthy'. Any dimension past TTL yields stale. A failed measurement yields measurement_failed, which is distinct from a measured failure.

content.success_condition: Every construct in the Universe APPLIES_IN this one canonical protocol: a type-level anatomy spine materialized as canonical graph relations and traversable through the stated spine_encoding; a runtime trace verified per firing and never stored as a static relation; and a verify arc in which an independent observer PRODUCES a metric vector that FEEDS health, whose fresh assessment EVIDENCES an explicit objective_satisfaction claim that MEASURES this objective. Each construct declares exactly one execution profile (reactive / deterministic / agentic) and is checked against the parts and feedback kinds that profile requires — never against a count. A construct is valid only while a FRESH, independently observed health_assessment evidences its satisfaction claim at a stated trust rung; a stale reading yields 'stale', never 'healthy'.

content.claim: This construct currently satisfies its objective.
content.freshness: A satisfaction claim has a fresh_until. Past it the state is 'stale', never its last value. A claim is never inherited from a prior revision of the construct.

content.why_it_exists: Health does not support an objective; an objective exists whether or not the thing pursuing it is healthy. What health bears on is the CONFIDENCE that the objective is currently satisfied. Attaching derived health straight to the objective conflates the two — and because SUPPORTS is the AtomDynamics bond polarity, that edge would modulate the objective's own energy rather than the confidence in its satisfaction.

content.loop_part: the design rationale / reusable shape of the protocol
content.pattern: An evidence-bearing spine that separates identity, execution, observation, measurement, health, satisfaction and repair, so no single scalar collapses them — and that separates the LEVELS at which those live: a type-level structure materialized in the graph, a per-firing trace that is never a graph fact, and a proof protocol that is universal over execution mechanisms that are not.

three_separations.claim_vs_evidence: ExpectedEffects vs CommittedDelta, health vs objective_satisfaction, self_reported vs kernel_verified — in each case a thing that is asserted and a thing that is measured, kept as two objects so no reader can mistake one for the other.
three_separations.protocol_vs_mechanism: Every construct must PROVE the same way. Almost none of them must RUN the same way. A gate, a counter, a validator and a projection need no inference; making inference universal both mis-describes them and caps the Universe's throughput at an LLM's.
three_separations.type_vs_trace: Structure is a permanent fact and belongs in the graph. A firing is an event and belongs in a Moment. Storing a firing as a relation makes the world claim something permanent about something that happened once.

content.why_a_loop_not_a_chain: The forward path alone is a chain that ends at health. It becomes a loop through TYPED feedback: epistemic (Preconditions -> justification), control (objective_satisfaction -> maintenance), state (Moment -> Inputs), environmental (CommittedDelta -> Sensor), invalidation (CommittedDelta -> Threshold), repair (maintenance -> implementation, through the ordinary effect protocol). Which of these a construct needs is decided by its execution profile, not by a count.

content.applies_to: every construct in the Universe, present and future — each APPLIES_IN this one protocol, declares exactly one execution profile, and reports its validity as the fresh, independently observed health this protocol derives. Not a capability toolkit (like sky/mechanical); the canonical protocol itself. This construct APPLIES_IN the protocol it defines, at the deterministic profile. Non-construct kernel entities are out of scope.

conformance_vocabulary.APPLIES_IN: CONFORMANCE. The construct's structure is claimed to satisfy this protocol. Semantic and validatable: a conformance check can pass or fail it. Every construct carries exactly one.
conformance_vocabulary.DEPENDS_ON: OPERATIONAL DEPENDENCY. The construct needs the target to do its work. Causal, not structural. Conformance implies nothing about it, and it implies nothing about conformance.
conformance_vocabulary.why_distinct: The prior revision had eight constructs pointing at this definition with DEPENDS_ON and read that as evidence of conformance. A dependency is not a conformance claim; it says the target is needed, not that the source is shaped correctly.

effect_protocol.CommittedDelta: Proven AFTER the commit, by reading the thing itself. The authoritative state of a node is the node.
effect_protocol.ExpectedEffects: Declared BEFORE the action, on the ActionIntent. A claim about what should happen. Never evidence.
chain: ActionIntent — what is being attempted, carrying ExpectedEffects (a declared claim, not a result)
validate + authorize — gates ON this step; a failure here ends the chain and is itself recorded
EffectIntent — the authorized request routed to an authorized transport
EffectReceipt — what the transport actually returned, including a failure or a timeout
CommitReceipt — the tick-boundary commit of the semantic transaction
CommittedDelta — read back independently from the node itself; this, not the Moment, is what proves the effect
forbidden: reporting ExpectedEffects as if they were a CommittedDelta
treating an EffectReceipt as proof of a semantic change (it proves a transport result, nothing more)
treating a Moment as a substitute for reading the node back
any path from a decision to a change that skips validate + authorize
effect_protocol.note: The one path from a decision to a proven change. No construct — including maintenance — has a shortcut around it.

agentic.clock_note: The inference paces THAT ACTOR'S TURN. It is not the Universe's clock: the causal/physics runtime is. An inference-paced world cannot reach the throughput a city needs, and the great majority of constructs never infer at all.
agentic.mechanism: one local Ollama inference, serial, one call in flight, assembling a bounded WorldObservation and returning a candidate IntentProposal
agentic.woken_by: self-wake on cognitive activity (L1 actors only; L2 and L3 never initiate)

deterministic.examples: a validator, a counter, a projection, a conformance check — and this construct itself
deterministic.mechanism: the fuel-bounded, mutation-free VM over a graph-native Causal IR CodeDefinition
deterministic.woken_by: invocation by another construct, or by an observer run; it does not self-wake

execution_profiles.note: The PROOF protocol is universal. The EXECUTION mechanism is not. A construct declares exactly one profile; the conformance check requires the parts and feedback kinds that profile needs, and forbids the rest.

reactive.examples: house alarm, seal gate, entry membrane, orientation beacon
reactive.mechanism: the construct's authored atom circuit: Sensor -> DepositBond -> trigger atom -> Threshold -> Effect
reactive.woken_by: a physics event crossing an authored threshold, reported by the solver for free (never a scan, never a poll)

content.lineage: The shared canonical model of what a construct IS. Its type-level anatomy spine is materialized as canonical graph relations; its runtime firing is a TRACE verified per Moment, never a static relation; its verify arc ends in an independently observed health assessment that EVIDENCES an explicit objective-satisfaction claim. Consumed by every construct through APPLIES_IN (conformance) and DEPENDS_ON (operational dependency); owned by no single toolkit. Promoted from the model first authored in [[space:l2:mind-universe:abstraction-toolkit-v0]].
content.name: Construct-validity v0 — the canonical construct protocol (every construct APPLIES_IN it)
content.native_law_boundary: AtomDynamics knows only AtomSpec, AtomBond and support/inhibit/neutral. This construct adds no law; it is the canonical DEFINITION of the protocol every construct conforms to. The parts, edges, profiles, runtime moments and maintenance affordances are data, not native dispatch. Because `support` is a bond polarity in that law, no semantic relation in this protocol is named SUPPORTS.

parent_scope.justification: A shared canonical contract awaiting installation under the sensemaking/meta registry Space. Exactly one scope classification; conformed to via APPLIES_IN and consumed via DEPENDS_ON, structurally owned by none.

protocol.closure_rule: A construct is causally closed when the feedback kinds its execution profile requires are present, each with the semantics its kind demands. Closure is a property of the KIND set, never of a count. A protocol that demanded all six of every construct would demand environmental feedback from a validator and inference from a counter.

counts.counts_are_not_a_conformance_rule: These describe THIS revision. A construct is never checked against a count. What is checked is: the required parts for its execution profile resolve, the type spine traverses, and the feedback kinds its profile requires are present.

feedback_edges.note: A dependency of knowledge, not a temporal loop. It re-injects no energy, no state and no action; it says each non-compensatory gate rests on the same independently measured evidence the objective is JUSTIFIED_BY.

Replaces the prior 'health SUPPORTS objective'. An unsatisfied or stale satisfaction claim raises a failure front that maintenance answers. This is the edge that actually re-drives the construct; the prior one only looked like it did.
Only what commits stays authoritative, and 'recent receipts' re-enter the WorldObservation that drives the next turn. Meaningless for a construct with no Inputs; required for an agentic one.

The changed world may produce new physics events. It does NOT follow that THIS construct re-wakes: the sensor that fires next may belong to another construct entirely. Declaring this edge REQUIRES declaring rearm_semantics (latch, consumption, reset, cooldown, hysteresis, dedup, idempotency); without them it is self-excitation, oscillation and repeated effect.

Mutating a claim invalidates its prior signature and re-opens the seal, so the signatures_valid support de-conducts and the gate cannot fire until re-sealed. A rule for SEALED constructs, not a universal law.

Repair re-enters implementation THROUGH the ordinary effect protocol — FailureFront -> RepairProposal -> ActionIntent -> validate -> authorize -> EffectIntent -> EffectReceipt -> Moment -> re-observation — never as a direct mutation. Maintenance holds no privileged authority.

protocol.note: The construct protocol. Parts and edges are described here as a MODEL; the type edges below are additionally materialized as canonical graph relations, and the trace edges deliberately are not.

anatomy.Affordances: The reachable action verbs, each with an exact target, precondition and justification; an unproven target is never offered as a verb.
anatomy.CommittedDelta: What actually changed, read back independently from the node after commit. The authoritative state of a node is the node; this is what proves an effect.
anatomy.ExpectedEffects: What the construct DECLARES it will change, carried on the ActionIntent before validation. A claim. Never evidence, never a receipt.
anatomy.Inputs: AGENTIC profile: what the turn consumes — the WorldObservation prompt (two frames plus context: role, needs and energy, memory, objective, recent receipts).
anatomy.Mechanism: How it works — DISPATCHED BY EXECUTION PROFILE. Reactive: the authored atom circuit. Deterministic: the fuel-bounded, mutation-free VM over graph-native Causal IR. Agentic: one local Ollama inference, serial, one in flight, pacing that actor's turn only. No profile's mechanism is the Universe's clock.
anatomy.Preconditions: Measured, all_required, non-compensatory conditions gating the Mechanism (missing_binding -> not_measured_and_inert); each gate DEPENDS_ON independently measured/observed evidence.
anatomy.Receipts: The durable record of what was asked and what a transport returned. Only what commits stays authoritative — and the record never stands in for looking.
anatomy.loop_space: The L2 construct spine; roots and GOVERNS the protocol instance and declares reads/writes/forbidden_effects and exactly one parent_scope. A Construct is what a Toolkit produces: the built, self-verifying thing placed in a world.

claim.objective_satisfaction: The explicit claim 'this construct currently satisfies its objective', standing between derived health and the objective itself. Health EVIDENCES it; it MEASURES the objective. Without it, derived health would attach directly to the objective — and since SUPPORTS is an atom bond polarity, that edge would modulate the objective's own energy rather than the confidence in its satisfaction.

maintenance.maintenance: Reversible repair affordances keyed to failing health states. Repair is an ORDINARY action: FailureFront -> RepairProposal -> ActionIntent -> validate -> authorize -> EffectIntent -> EffectReceipt -> Moment -> re-observation. Maintenance has no privileged write path; a repair system exempt from the guarantees it repairs is the largest hole a construct can have.

roles.algorithm: Role 5/12: the ordered steps refining behavior; DEFINED_BY code.
roles.behavior: Role 4/12: the given/when/then/forbidden observable contract; SHAPED by pattern, USES_VOCABULARY, REFINED_BY algorithm, VALIDATED_BY validation.
roles.code: Role 6/12: the graph-native CodeDefinition (causal-expression-ast / health AST / atom circuit), no implicit Python; REALIZED_BY implementation, CHALLENGED_BY validation.
roles.health: Role 12/12: derived state (healthy/degraded/stale/unknown/not_measured/measurement_failed) from a fresh metric vector; FED by metric, EVIDENCES objective_satisfaction, REPAIRED_BY maintenance.
roles.implementation: Role 7/12: the honest realized state with graph-defined/wired/running/verified kept as DISTINCT fields; REALIZED_BY code, OBSERVED_BY the observer.
roles.justification: Role 8/12: whyItSatisfiesObjective plus rejectedAlternatives (the roads not taken); the objective is JUSTIFIED_BY this, and every gate DEPENDS_ON the same evidence.
roles.metric: Role 11/12: the metric VECTOR (forbidOpaqueAggregate; per-dimension spec, provenance and freshness, no collapsed scalar); PRODUCED by the observer, FEEDS health.
roles.objective: Role 1/12: the observable success_condition / semantic promise; GOVERNED by loop_space, JUSTIFIED_BY justification, and MEASURED by objective_satisfaction.
roles.observability_algorithm: Role 10/12: the INDEPENDENT observer; mustNotTrust implementation health claim / renderer success flag / process running state / file presence; OBSERVES implementation via readback, PRODUCES the metric, is itself VERIFIED_BY observer_validation and carries its own trust_provenance rung.
roles.pattern: Role 2/12: the design rationale / reusable shape (evidence-bearing spine that separates identity, execution, observation, measurement, health and repair); ADDRESSES objective, SHAPES behavior.
roles.validation: Role 9/12: fixtures plus invariants challenging code/behavior; its execution PRODUCES a validation_run (never pre-created).
roles.vocabulary: Role 3/12: the terms plus forbiddenConflations (running!=healthy, empty!=known_absent, missing_value!=0, rendered!=committed, file_exists!=deployed, expected!=committed, conformance!=dependency); USED by behavior.

runtime_moment.ActionIntent: The intent a PhysicsEvent is lifted into (or the IntentProposal the L3 body attempts); carries ExpectedEffects; validated and authorized before any effect.
runtime_moment.EffectIntent: After validate + authorize, the authorized request routed to an authorized transport.
runtime_moment.EffectReceipt: What the transport actually returned — success, failure or timeout. Proof of a transport result, never of a semantic change.
runtime_moment.IntentProposal: AGENTIC only: the candidate the inference returns — one chosen verb on an exact target with its justification. The model proposes; the world disposes; the inference never touches the store.
runtime_moment.Moment: The committed terminal of the chain: the authoritative, inspectable record (CommitReceipt / inscription_receipt).
runtime_moment.PhysicsEvent: The observed sensor intersection / threshold event; it never mutates the Universe directly.
runtime_moment.health_assessment: Produced by health derivation from a FRESH metric vector (precreated:false): assessment_id, observer_run_ref, trust_rung, metric_samples, derived_state, derived_at, fresh_until, evidence_refs, failure_front.
runtime_moment.validation_run: Produced by validation execution (precreated:false): run_id, construct_id, validation_id, fixture_results, invariant_results, evidence_refs, execution_status.
runtime_moment.wake-queue: The physics step fills it; the single continuous serial loop drains it so each construct takes its turn and dormant constructs cost nothing.

trigger.DepositBond: REACTIVE part 2: on the physics event, +energy onto a trigger atom — a Support BOND (atom polarity, not a semantic relation), stamped energy_status measured.
trigger.Sensor: REACTIVE profile part 1: a physical condition (e.g. a collider on an entry membrane) placed in the field. Self-wake, never poll.
trigger.Threshold: REACTIVE part 3: the atom fires at support >= N; the moment-to-act is a threshold the solver reports for free, not a scan.
trigger.rearm_semantics: A threshold that fires must state its re-arm discipline, or environmental feedback becomes self-excitation: latch, energy consumption on fire, reset/rearm condition, cooldown, hysteresis, causal de-duplication key, and idempotency key. A construct that declares environmental feedback without these is non-conformant.
trigger.trigger atom: The atom a DepositBond deposits +energy onto; accrues supporting energy and fires once support >= N.

agentic_chain: Inputs -> consumed as the WorldObservation prompt -> Mechanism
Affordances -> offered to the inference (proven targets only) -> IntentProposal
wake-queue -> the serial loop drains it, giving each construct its turn -> Mechanism
Mechanism -> the inference returns a candidate -> IntentProposal
IntentProposal -> rises to the L3 body, which attempts it -> ActionIntent
effect_chain: Preconditions -> gate the mechanism (all_required, non-compensatory) -> Mechanism
ActionIntent -> carries what it claims it will change -> ExpectedEffects
Moment -> read the node back independently -> CommittedDelta
trace_edges.note: The shape of ONE firing. These are NOT graph relations and must never be stored as such: a firing is an event, not a permanent fact about the world. A conformance check verifies this shape against a committed Moment chain, per firing, and reports `not_measured` when no firing has occurred.
reactive_chain: implementation -> wired into the field -> Sensor
Sensor -> physics event fires the sensor -> DepositBond
trigger atom -> fires at support >= N -> Threshold
Threshold -> enqueues the woken construct -> wake-queue
Sensor -> the intersection is observed (never mutates) -> PhysicsEvent
PhysicsEvent -> lifted (never mutates the Universe) -> ActionIntent
verify_chain: CommittedDelta -> independently re-observed as fresh evidence -> observability_algorithm

content.purpose: Give the Universe one shared, canonical protocol every construct APPLIES_IN: a type-level anatomy spine materialized in the graph, a runtime trace verified per firing, and a verify arc whose independently observed health EVIDENCES an explicit satisfaction claim about the objective. A construct is valid only while a FRESH, independently observed health_assessment evidences that claim; a stale reading yields 'stale', never 'healthy'. The protocol is universal; the execution mechanism is not.

revision_gate.additionally_required: If the TARGET construct declares its own `capability_gate`, that port must admit as well. Both gates are required; neither substitutes for the other.
revision_gate.note: The door to revising ANY construct that APPLIES_IN this protocol. It is DATA, read from this node at revision time; it is not a constant in a binary. A revision tool that cannot find this gate in the graph must refuse — there is no fallback, because a fallback would silently replace missing Universe state with a native default and that is exactly how an ungated write path is reintroduced.
revision_gate.receipt: An admitted revision commits an EffectReceipt Moment in the SAME atomic transaction as the change, so there is no window in which a canonical construct is revised without an attributable holder behind it. A refused revision commits a REJECTION receipt recording the actor's actually-held set and the required capability, so the refusal is audited rather than silently dropped.
revision_gate.rule: A construct revision is admitted only when the acting capability set — READ from the actor's graph-held USED edges, never from a self-declared request field — contains authority:construct-revision. Perceiving a construct, depending on it, or conforming to it grants none of it.
revision_gate.why_a_gate_here: Revising a construct changes what it promises, what its invariants forbid, and — for this construct — the protocol every other construct conforms to. That is a heavier act than changing a file under the city, and it should be held by an actor with a name, not available to whoever runs a binary. Before this gate, `revise_construct` wrote six transactions attributed to nobody.

changed: DELETED the invariant 'the loop has 34 parts and 42 edges, exactly 6 of which are feedback' — a count is a description of one revision, never a conformance rule.

SPLIT the single edge list into type_edges (materialized as canonical graph relations, traversable and validatable) and trace_edges (the shape of ONE firing; verified per Moment, never stored as a static relation).
ADDED spine_encoding: the authored spine predicate -> canonical stored predicate map, with direction, so the stored graph provably encodes the spine and interns zero new symbols.

REPLACED 'health SUPPORTS objective' with 'health EVIDENCES objective_satisfaction SATISFIES objective'. SUPPORTS is the AtomDynamics bond polarity; a semantic claim edge must never share a name with an atom polarity, or derived health would deposit energy onto the objective itself.

SPLIT the 'Effects' part into ExpectedEffects (declared before the action; a claim) and CommittedDelta (proven after the commit; read back from the node), and DELETED the duplicate EffectIntent -> Effects -> Receipts path.
TYPED the feedback edges by kind (epistemic / control / state / environmental / invalidation / repair) instead of one boolean.

ADDED execution_profiles (reactive / deterministic / agentic). The prior Mechanism mandated one local Ollama inference for EVERY construct and called the inference 'the clock'. A gate, a counter, a validator and a projection need no LLM, and an inference-paced clock cannot reach the throughput the Universe needs.

ADDED trust_provenance: a graded, terminating ladder (self_reported < observed < cross_observed < fixture_verified < kernel_verified) so 'who validates the observer's validation' stops at an inspectable root instead of recursing.

ADDED metric dimension_specs: per dimension, what measures it, its type, the provenance it requires, its freshness TTL and how it composes into health — the declarations a health derivation must have to be a program rather than a description.
ROUTED maintenance through the ordinary effect protocol: repair is an ActionIntent like any other, never a privileged direct mutation of implementation.

GATED revision itself. Added revision_gate: revising any construct that APPLIES_IN this protocol now requires authority:construct-revision, READ from the acting actor's graph-held USED edges and adjudicated by a SealedCapabilityPort. A refusal commits a rejection receipt; an admission commits its EffectReceipt in the SAME transaction as the change. The gate was placed by one last ungated write (store revision 320) and enforced from then on — the same chicken-and-egg bootstrap the underground toolkit had.
revision_reason.prior_shape: 34 parts / 42 edges / 6 boolean feedback edges, carried entirely as root content
rejected: Materializing all 42 edges as graph relations. Roughly two thirds of them are trace edges (Sensor -> DepositBond -> trigger atom -> Threshold -> ... -> Moment). Storing a firing as a permanent fact would cement exactly the conflation of the three loops that this revision separates.

Renaming the stored relations to the spine predicates. GOVERNS / ADDRESSED_BY / SHAPES / REFINED_BY / REALIZED_BY are not canonical symbols; minting them is a hard error by design. The spine is ENCODED in canonical predicates and the encoding is now stated, which is traversable where a renamed symbol set would not be.

Adding ValidationReceipt / AuthorizationReceipt / TransportAttempt as node kinds. Validation and authorization are gates ON the ActionIntent -> EffectIntent step; a transport attempt is what an EffectReceipt records. Three new kinds to disambiguate a naming collision is not worth its cost; naming ExpectedEffects vs CommittedDelta resolves it.
Keeping a count as an invariant so the model has a memorable closure. Numerology promoted to a conformance rule breaks the moment the protocol splits by execution profile — which it now does.
revision_reason.why: The prior revision described one undifferentiated 34-part / 42-edge loop as CONTENT while the graph carried only ten type-level relations. That is not two ontologies; it is one spine with an unstated encoding, plus a runtime trace that was never a graph fact. This revision (a) states the encoding, (b) separates type edges from trace edges, (c) replaces the health->objective energy edge with an explicit satisfaction claim, (d) splits declared from committed effects, (e) types the feedback edges, and (f) stops assuming every construct is an inferring agent.

spine_encoding.note: The type-level spine is authored in spine vocabulary and STORED in canonical predicates. This table is the encoding, carried in the graph so a reader can traverse the stored edges and recover the spine. Interning a new symbol for a spine predicate is a hard error; encoding it is not a compromise but the mechanism by which the spine stays traversable.

role_bindings.note: Which entity each type_edge role name resolves to. Data, so a conformance check needs no naming convention baked into native code.

why_these_canonical_choices.EVIDENCES -> SUPPORTS_ESTIMATE: The canonical predicate for 'this evidence bears on that estimate' is exactly what a health assessment does to a satisfaction claim — and unlike SUPPORTS it is not an atom bond polarity.
why_these_canonical_choices.SATISFIES -> MEASURES: A satisfaction claim is a measurement OF the objective, not a part of it.
why_these_canonical_choices.SHAPES -> DERIVED_FROM (swapped): Nearest canonical predicate; the behavior is derived from the pattern.
why_these_canonical_choices.USES_VOCABULARY -> USED: The behavior holds and uses the vocabulary. DEPENDS_ON was rejected here: this protocol gives DEPENDS_ON one job — the operational edge BETWEEN constructs, the counterpart of APPLIES_IN — and reusing it for an intra-construct relation would blur exactly the distinction the conformance_vocabulary draws.

ladder: self_reported — the thing's own account of itself. Never evidence. Carried, never derived from.
observed — read back independently from the store by a party that is not the implementation.
cross_observed — two independent observers agree, at least one of which did not author the construct.
fixture_verified — the observer itself passed a deterministic fault-injection fixture (it detected a planted fault and refused a planted missing proof).
kernel_verified — the claim rests only on trusted-computing-base primitives: atomic write, independent readback, signature check, fuel bound.
trust_provenance.note: Terminates the 'who validates the validator' recursion at an inspectable root instead of recursing forever. A proof carries its rung; a construct never reports a rung it did not earn.
trust_provenance.root: kernel_verified is the root and does not recurse: it names the small, fixed set of native primitives whose correctness is assumed by everything else. Every other rung states what it assumed.
trust_provenance.rule: An observer that has not reached fixture_verified yields a WEAK proof, and the health assessment it feeds must say so. A weak proof is never upgraded by repetition.

members.name: Construct-validity v0 — the canonical construct protocol (every construct APPLIES_IN it)

deleted_invariants.the loop has 34 parts and 42 edges, exac: A count describes one revision; it is not a property a construct can be right or wrong about. It also could not survive the split by execution profile, under which different constructs correctly have different parts and different feedback kinds.

invariants: every type edge in the protocol resolves to a canonical stored relation through spine_encoding, and interning a new symbol to make one resolve is a failure, not a fix
no trace edge appears as a graph relation
each construct declares exactly one execution_profile, and carries the parts and feedback kinds that profile requires and no parts claimed from another
runtime moments (validation_run, health_assessment, objective_satisfaction) are produced, never pre-created
the observer does not trust the implementation's health claim, renderer flag, running state or file presence, and states the trust rung it earned
health is derived only from a fresh metric vector, and every dimension has a spec, provenance and a freshness TTL
health EVIDENCES objective_satisfaction; no relation attaches health to the objective directly, and no semantic relation is named SUPPORTS
an effect is proven by independent node readback, never by a receipt or a Moment alone
maintenance reaches implementation only through the ordinary effect protocol
conformance (APPLIES_IN) is never inferred from dependency (DEPENDS_ON)
no construct is revised except by an actor whose GRAPH-HELD capability set contains the revision_gate's required_mutate_capability; a self-declared capability field is audited, never adjudicated
an admitted revision and its EffectReceipt commit in ONE transaction, so no revised construct exists without an attributable holder behind it
this construct APPLIES_IN the protocol it defines, at the deterministic profile
content.loop_part: fixtures plus invariants challenging code/behavior; its execution PRODUCES a validation_run (never pre-created)

content.consequence: An observer below fixture_verified yields only a WEAK proof, and the health assessment it feeds must carry that rung. Repetition never upgrades a weak proof.
content.loop_part: proves the observer detects real faults and never converts missing proof into success; observability_algorithm is VALIDATED_BY it
content.recursion_terminates_at: kernel_verified — the fixed set of trusted-computing-base primitives (atomic write, independent readback, signature check, fuel bound) whose correctness is assumed rather than proven here. The ladder is finite by construction; what each rung assumed is stated, so the assumption is inspectable rather than hidden.
content.role: observer_validation — the check on the checker
tests: detect a broken-but-visible edge the implementation reported as fine
detect a missing proof presented as success
detect stale evidence reused as fresh
detect a renderer 'success' flag that never committed (rendered != committed)
detect the implementation self-reporting health the observer never measured
detect ExpectedEffects presented as a CommittedDelta
detect a trace edge stored as a graph relation
detect a satisfaction claim asserted without a fresh health assessment behind it
detect a trust rung claimed above what the proof earned
never convert missing proof into an overall pass

forbiddenConflations: SUPPORTS (atom bond polarity) != any semantic relation
content.loop_part: the terms of the protocol and the conflations it forbids

terms.CommittedDelta: What was PROVEN after the commit, by reading the node. Evidence.
terms.ExpectedEffects: What was DECLARED before the action. A claim.
terms.IntentProposal: AGENTIC only: one chosen verb on an exact target with its justification; the model proposes, the world disposes; the inference never touches the store.
terms.construct_protocol: A type-level anatomy spine, a per-firing runtime trace and a verify arc, closed by the typed feedback kinds the construct's execution profile requires.
terms.execution_profile: reactive | deterministic | agentic. Declared exactly once per construct; decides which parts and which feedback kinds conformance requires.
terms.health_assessment: The runtime moment health derivation PRODUCES from a fresh metric vector; never pre-created.
terms.loop_space: The L2 construct spine that roots and GOVERNS the protocol instance; declares reads/writes/forbidden_effects and exactly one parent_scope.
terms.maintenance: Reversible repair affordances keyed to failing health states, reaching implementation through the ordinary effect protocol and no other way.
terms.objective_satisfaction: The explicit claim that the construct currently satisfies its objective; what health evidences, and what the objective is measured by.
terms.trace_edge: The shape of one firing. Verified against a committed Moment chain, per firing. NEVER a graph relation.
terms.trigger: REACTIVE only: Sensor -> DepositBond -> trigger atom -> Threshold, plus the rearm_semantics that keep it from self-exciting.
terms.trust_rung: self_reported | observed | cross_observed | fixture_verified | kernel_verified. Every proof carries the rung it earned.
terms.type_edge: A permanent structural fact about the construct. Materialized as a canonical graph relation through spine_encoding; traversable and validatable.

notes: The member set comes from a bounded heuristic (id-suffix match + construct-internal relation closure + satellite content references). A member the heuristic does not reach is `unknown`, never `known_absent`.

This document is a definition read from the graph. It carries no runtime evidence: nothing here can say `healthy`, `correct` or `objective satisfied`. Absence of a runtime moment is reported, not interpreted.
The store is a durable projection, not the truth. The revision above states which view this was taken from; a later revision may hold something else.

origin.vantage: read-only replay of the durable store projection (open + load_snapshot + replay + read_content); no event appended, no transaction committed

self_report.note: These fields are the implementation's OWN account of itself. They are carried here so a reader can see what the construct claims about itself; they are not evidence, and nothing in this document was derived from them.
